g.text: Animation round trip: Blender -> GLB -> Vizij

text.tspan: The fingerprint covers what a consumer could change: which node and property each curve
drives, its interpolation, and its sampled values -- rounded, because a GLB float round trip is
not bit-exact. It ignores animation name and curve order, so a reordering export is not an edit.
